commentPctNotes: src/parser/script/ is copied code: its comment share is browser/js/core/script's, and only a change there can move it. src/parser/ itself reads high because the copies moved down into script/ and left index.js's banner behind — the prose did not grow, the code under it left.
filesNotes: src/ only. The tests grow as the suite does; the 230-line cap is their ratchet.

_notes.commentPct: commentPct was re-measured when the walker began counting .d.ts files: a shape file is mostly declarations with a documenting line above each, so every directory holding one reads a few points higher. No prose was added — the measured scope grew. These are the new floors.

_dirsNote: tests/ mirrors src/ folder for folder; its root covers the modules at src/ root, several of which carry more than one test file.
